dialogues.speaker: Harjo
dialogues.text: Ahaha, of course not! But why would you suddenly say something like that?

dialogues.speaker: Harjo
dialogues.text: ...Huh? What's that? It's a place of exile for criminals? But that would make it... a prison!

dialogues.speaker: Harjo
dialogues.text: No wonder the Gestionnaire who told me about it looked so serious.

dialogues.speaker: Harjo
dialogues.text: Don't worry about me. I may seem casual and carefree, but in matters of honor, I am always serious.

dialogues.speaker: Harjo
dialogues.text: Even when it comes to disputes, there's always a line to be drawn between honor and disgrace. Starting a conflict for the wrong reasons is certain to backfire.
